name: Trio
comment: Trio — ChatGPT answers, Claude checks, a third AI from another company names only what both missed. The third voice works on FREE keys — NVIDIA (Kimi, DeepSeek, GLM), Google AI Studio (Gemini), OpenRouter or Groq, any number of them — kept in iCloud Drive → Shortcuts → poly-key.txt, one per line, never inside this shortcut, so sharing the shortcut never shares a key. Trio tries every key and every free model until one answers. ChatGPT: Start new chat ON, Continuous OFF.
ask.question: What do you want to ask the trio?
ask.key:
Paste any FREE AI key — you can paste several, each on a new line. Trio tries all of them until one answers (asked once, saved in iCloud Drive → Shortcuts → poly-key.txt, never inside the shortcut).

A minute each, no card:
• build.nvidia.com/settings/api-keys → Generate API Key (the strongest: Kimi, DeepSeek, GLM; starts with nvapi-; asks for a phone number)
• aistudio.google.com/apikey → Create API key (Gemini, starts with AIza)
• openrouter.ai/keys → Create key (dozens of free models, starts with sk-or-)
• console.groq.com/keys → Create API Key (starts with gsk_)

On the first run iPhone will ask for permission 4–5 times — tap «Allow» each time, right away (a window left unanswered closes and the shortcut says it «can't access»).
notify.start: 🎻 Trio [1/3]: ChatGPT answers… ≈1.5 min, don't touch the phone. If ChatGPT says «logged out» — open its app and rerun Trio.
notify.step2: [2/3] Claude is checking and writing the final answer…
notify.step3: [3/3] The third voice is looking for what both missed — trying your free keys one by one… (Claude's answer is already in the clipboard)
notify.done: ✅ Trio: the answer and the third voice are in the clipboard
why.billing: the money on this key has run out (402) — this key is spent; a free key from another account or provider works
why.key: the key is invalid or deleted (401)
why.limit: free limit reached (429) — per minute or for today
why.model: the model is gone or renamed (404)
why.other: no answer (no internet, or the provider refused)
error.all:
⚠️ None of your free keys answered this time — Claude's answer above is complete. What each one said:{L}

What to do: «overloaded» and «limit» pass in a minute or by tomorrow — run Trio again. For «money ran out» or «invalid» add another free key: open Files → iCloud Drive → Shortcuts → poly-key.txt and paste it on a new line (or delete the file — Trio will ask again). The most reliable addition is an OpenRouter key: openrouter.ai/keys — dozens of free models from different companies.
error.nokeys: ⚠️ poly-key.txt holds no key Trio recognises (they start with nvapi-, AIza, sk-or- or gsk_). Open Files → iCloud Drive → Shortcuts, delete poly-key.txt and run Trio again — it will ask for keys. Claude's answer above is complete.
